items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15; all volumes (5, 4, 1 µL) are handled with the p20 within 1–20 µL, and the distribute uses 5+2 µL aspirations. A 10 µL reaction fits the wells, and the right labware is used.

One tip distributes master mix into empty wells (allowed). Every primer pair and every colony gets a fresh tip that is dropped. The tip_before_aspirate, no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end checks all pass.

The 4 µL primer volume rests on an invented 1.25 µM pre-mixed stock with no water step. The agent chose 35 cycles and a 3 min lysis step, added a spin-down and gel analysis, and the pcr_plate end_state check failed, so it is not fully faithful.
The agent distributes 5 µL Q5 2x master mix (1x final) into every well first, then 4 µL of the colony's primer pair, then 1 µL colony template, giving a 10 µL reaction.
zip(colony_wells, pcr_wells) and zip(primer_wells, pcr_wells) over wells()[:96] map A1→A1 through H12→H12, each used once.
A comment records plate sealing, then 98 °C 3 min, 35 cycles of 98/62/72 °C, 72 °C 2 min final extension and a 4 °C hold. These are suitable Q5 conditions.

judge.summary: The protocol is sound robot practice with correct tip handling, well mapping, reaction order and a Q5-suitable cycling comment. It fails the all-or-nothing fidelity item because it invents a 4 µL primer volume and assumed primer stock concentration, uses 35 cycles and a 3 min denaturation, and adds extra steps, so it deviates from the paper's 9 µL mix plus 1 µL template scheme.
